weather_report:
This morning, Boston awakens to a tapestry of blue skies and a gentle chill, ushering in a day that promises to be mostly sunny, inviting the spirits of autumn into every corner of the city. As the sun climbs, the air warms to a delightful 69 degrees, although a subtle dip in temperature will brush against the skin by afternoon, leaving us with a pleasant 63. A soft southwest wind whispers through the trees, just enough to carry the rustling leaves and the faint scent of turned earth, creating a backdrop for the pleasant rhythm of daily life.

Tonight will bring a comforting wrap of partly cloudy skies, with temperatures settling around 47 degrees – a reminder of the season's embrace as we slip into evening. In such splendid conditions, one might consider donning a light jacket or a snug sweater, perfect for a casual stroll along the Esplanade or perhaps sipping warm cider at one of the local cafés. Taking advantage of this glorious weather, a short bike ride or a visit to a nearby park may invigorate the senses, settling the heart in a gentle rhythm with the pulse of the season. As the day unfolds, it invites both reflection and leisure, urging us to savor the simple pleasures that the brisk air provides.
